description: Real Renovate config for renovate-mcp, also kept as a showcase. Edit with this repo's preview_custom_manager (iterate on regex managers) and lint_config (catch Renovate-specific footguns), then dry_run before committing.

packageRules.description: npm rejects lockfile-only updates for packages listed in `overrides` (EOVERRIDE: override spec must equal the requested spec). Bump the override range in package.json instead.
claude-code-action releases very frequently; propose its updates at most once per week to reduce PR churn.
jsonata is pinned to whatever Renovate itself pins. Don't open standalone PRs for it; the renovate-bump postUpgradeTask below syncs the pin.

On every renovate dependency bump: (1) mark the commit `fix` (not config:recommended's `chore` default for it) so release-please cuts a release that ships the freshly regenerated snapshots; (2) sync the jsonata pin to Renovate's own pin and regenerate the committed snapshots under src/data/ so they stay in lockstep with the installed Renovate version. The postUpgradeTasks require the operator's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS to permit `npm ci`, `npm install`, `npm run sync:jsonata-pin`, and the three `npm run generate:*` commands.
